issueRepository.description: Repository issues are sourced from, in 'owner/repo' format, when it differs from 'repository' (where code changes and pull requests land). Defaults to 'repository'.

targetSpec.description: Optional issue number(s) of Spec(s) to scope execution strictly to child tickets

targetSpecs.description: Optional list of Spec issue numbers to scope execution strictly to child tickets

baseBranch.description: The base branch to branch off of and merge PRs into

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel agent worktrees to run simultaneously

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Frequency in seconds to poll GitHub issues

extraPrompt.description: Additional custom instructions or context injected into every agent prompt across the repository (e.g. environment setup, copy untracked .env files, styling rules)

customRunnerCommand.description: Shell command template if runner is set to 'custom'

autoMerge.description: Whether to automatically merge the Pull Request if tests pass

mergeMethod.description: Git merge strategy for Pull Requests

cleanupWorktreeOnClose.description: Whether to automatically delete the worktree and branch once the issue is merged and closed

remote.description: Remote control and notification settings (e.g. Telegram bot)

botTokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the Telegram bot token

allowedUserIds.description: Whitelisted Telegram user IDs allowed to interact with the bot

defaultChatId.description: Default Telegram chat ID or channel username for milestone notifications

needsInfo.description: Notify when an agent requires developer feedback (needs-info)

quotaPaused.description: Notify when quota limit is reached and workers are paused

taskCompleted.description: Notify when a task is completed and PR is created/merged

specCompleted.description: Notify when all child tickets of a parent spec are completed

pauseOnLimit.description: Automatically pause active workers when quota threshold is reached or exceeded

utilizationThresholdLimit.description: Proactive quota utilization threshold to pause task execution (e.g. 0.70 for 70%)

proxyPort.description: Port for optional rate-limit interceptor proxy

readyForAgent.description: Label indicating an issue is ready for autonomous agent execution

needsInfo.description: Label indicating agent has paused and requested human feedback

readyForHuman.description: Label indicating issue requires human review or manual intervention

needsTriage.description: Label for newly filed issues awaiting triage
